# Brushline

> Agent-facing index for Brushline. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home for the project.
- [Design record](design/index.html): the scope, architecture, optimization, UI, LiDAR, instance-builder, demo-portal, and literature review decisions.
- [Contract index](reference/contract-index.html): every schema, validator, error prefix, and test layer.
- [FEMIC extension boundary](reference/femic-boundary.html): exact pins, providers, nodes, commands, contracts, and drift policy.
- [Instance template](reference/instance-template.html): the Brushline overlay, the two rebuild specs, configuration, and validation.
- [FreshForge provider](reference/freshforge-provider.html): the six Brushline nodes, their commands, validation, and offline tests.
- [Data catalogue and connectors](reference/data-catalogue.html): public sources, private connectors, licences, classifications, the secret scan, and the agent approval gate.
- [Fetch plan, materialization, and coverage](reference/fetch-plan.html): plan-only estimates, bulk approval, checksums, pointers, six coverage states, and the gap decision.
- [Agent capabilities](reference/agent-capabilities.html): the six bounded capabilities, tool allowlists, validators, retry budgets, and sanitized outcome records.
- [Model builder](reference/model-builder.html): the map-to-instance prototype, plan preview, approvals, dry run, progress stream, review, and handoff.
- [FEMIC LiDAR bundle](reference/lidar-bundle.html): the read-only producer bundle contract, manifest and selection checks, product provenance, and named errors.
- [Terrain and slope support](reference/terrain-support.html): buffered segment aggregation, slope, aspect, terrain classes, the access proxy, and coverage states.
- [Canopy and cover support](reference/canopy-support.html): CHM height and cover statistics, optional structure and tree products, VRI comparison, and applicability states.
- [Initial vegetation state](reference/state-initialization.html): field-first rules, conservative CHM thresholds, explicit unknown/partial states, class probabilities, and audit decisions.
- [LiDAR coverage and applicability](reference/lidar-coverage.html): acquisition recency, usable coverage, domain checks, missing observation gaps, and the stop/continue decision.
- [LiDAR benchmark](reference/lidar-benchmark.html): the offline FEMIC/WS4/FHOPS comparison, shared measurement contract, tolerances, missing-value rules, and report statuses.
- [Low-vegetation state space](reference/state-space.html): functional groups, variables, discretization, class probabilities, uncertainty, and projection to the state contract.
- [Growth model](reference/growth-model.html): saturating group-specific growth, site/climate/competition modifiers, uncertainty, and the out-of-domain rule.
- [Treatment transitions](reference/treatment-transitions.html): method and season priors, top-kill, resprouting, regrowth delay, cost hooks, and the post-delay trajectory.
- [Treatment calibration](reference/treatment-calibration.html): before/after evidence, pooling, shrinkage, intervals, leave-one-out checks, and calibrated parameters.
- [Hazard and service indicators](reference/hazard-indicators.html): clearance, fall-in, fuel connectivity, access, reliability weights, formulas, and caveats.
- [Held-out vegetation validation](reference/vegetation-validation.html): spatial holdout, group error, interval coverage, time-lag sensitivity, and candidate benchmark.
- [Low-vegetation model card](reference/low-vegetation-model-card.html): predictors, evidence, metrics, uncertainty, applicability domain, and out-of-domain rejection.
- [Optimization formulation](reference/optimization-formulation.html): variables, treatment/monitoring options, constraints, and the four-objective vector.
- [Optimization evaluator](reference/optimization-evaluator.html): exact replay, objectives, costs, violations, and the full-evaluation fallback.
- [Optimization move operators](reference/optimization-operators.html): toggle, method, shift, swap, block, monitoring, destroy-repair, locks, access, and repair.
- [Optimization adapter and replay](reference/optimization-adapter.html): the Fresh Solutions contract, scalarizations, search modes, checkpoints, and exact replay.
- [Multi-objective archive](reference/optimization-archive.html): non-dominance, crowding, eviction, pareto.json, and promotion records.
- [Tiny-instance validation](reference/optimization-validation.html): exhaustive enumeration, exact/batch agreement, known optimum, search gap, and replay.
- [Search budget and performance](reference/optimization-budget.html): quality-versus-budget, seed variance, scaling, checkpoint cost, and the no-optimality statement.
- [Studio telemetry](reference/optimization-telemetry.html): versioned progress events, SSE, archive references, and the compatibility check.
- [Strategic dynamic program](reference/strategic-dynamic-program.html): state/action transitions, reward, backward induction, policy, and expected outcomes.
- [Strategic portfolio](reference/strategic-portfolio.html): budget, capacity, service/risk targets, continuity, and deterministic selection.
- [Strategic monitoring](reference/strategic-monitoring.html): frequency, route, sensor, sampling, cost, and value of information.
- [Business-as-usual baseline](reference/strategic-bau.html): fixed cycles, budget/capacity enforcement, and the optimized comparison.
- [Strategic reports](reference/strategic-reports.html): yearly cost, budget, service, risk, uncertainty, monitoring, and BAU rows.
- [Strategic scenario](reference/strategic-scenario.html): versions, canonical digests, replay, and the scenario archive.
- [Synthetic strategic validation](reference/strategic-validation.html): 10-year coverage, budget, service, monitoring, BAU, totals, and replay checks.
- [Tactical program](reference/tactical-program.html): treatment units, actions, seasons, budgets, and contractor allocation.
- [Tactical resources](reference/tactical-resources.html): contractor capacity, rates, travel, supervision, overhead, risk, and cost lines.
- [Tactical access](reference/tactical-access.html): source-preserving road status, windows, route length, and no invented open/closed verdict.
- [Operational work plan](reference/tactical-operations.html): work orders, crew/day assignment, access gates, and traceability.
- [FHOPS adapter](reference/tactical-fhops.html): pinned optional boundary, tactical mapping, dry-run productivity/cost, and explicit no-live-run notes.
- [Operations timeline](reference/tactical-timeline.html): timestamped events, crew/machine/segment ids, known/unknown positions, and cost.
- [Tactical validation](reference/tactical-validation.html): capacity, access, seasonality, traceability, FHOPS dry-run, and timeline checks.
- [Observation model](reference/observation-model.html): coverage, detection, confusion, error, and latency.
- [Compiled dataset contract](reference/compiled-dataset.html): the manifest, table, column, and validation contract.
- [Corridor graph contract](reference/corridor-contract.html): corridors, segments, spans, treatment units, access, structures, and service standards.
- [State and treatment contract](reference/state-contract.html): vegetation states, treatments, transitions, observations, ranges, and referential checks.
- [Artifact contracts](reference/artifacts.html): plan, run, Pareto archive, operations timeline, and demo manifest.
- [Synthetic corridor fixture](reference/synthetic-fixture.html): the deterministic two-corridor example, expected values, warnings, and tiny known optimum.
- [Prototype compile and simulate](reference/prototype.html): the end-to-end CLI, prototype growth and treatment rules, accounts, and run artifacts.
- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.

- [Mission simulation](reference/mission.html): corridor graph, endurance, footprint, weather, and cost.

- [Recalibration](reference/recalibration.html): posterior state, uncertainty, parameter, and model record.

- [Field comparison](reference/field-comparison.html): observed-versus-LiDAR residuals, unit bias, sample gates, and non-applied review multipliers.
- [Shift scheduling](reference/shift-scheduling.html): crew/machine skills, daily shift capacity, travel, split work, utilization, and limits.
- [Uncertainty and sensitivity](reference/uncertainty.html): seeded cost/productivity/capacity bands, budget and shortfall probabilities, and one-at-a-time stresses.
- [Scenario-optimized planning](reference/scenario-optimization.html): hindsight adaptive MILP re-solves, fixed-plan budget/capacity feasibility, cost/risk bands, and regret.
- [Planning brief](reference/planning-brief.html): one-click self-contained decision record with frontier, tactical schedule, uncertainty, adaptation, caveats, and commit provenance.
- [Rolling-horizon policy](reference/rolling-policy.html): executable persistence-forecast policy, annual re-solves, state carry-over, cost/risk bands, and limits.
- [Static budget-headroom plans](reference/static-plan.html): frontier candidates tested against a common actual budget, with budget-violation rates and risk trade-offs.
- [Weather and outage stress](reference/operational-stress.html): assumed first-year calendar, completion rate, and unscheduled work.
- [Weather/outage remedies](reference/operational-remedies.html): added crew/machine capacity versus scope reduction and longer windows.
- [Risk-ranked scope deferral](reference/risk-ranked-scope.html): whole-action deferral by first-year risk reduction per hour, with risk loss and completion trade-offs.
- [Multi-year risk trajectory](reference/risk-trajectory.html): fixed-future replay of first-year deferral risk through 2031.
- [Rolling recovery](reference/rolling-recovery.html): future re-optimization after first-year deferral, recovery gaps, and cost.
- [Out-of-sample recovery](reference/out-of-sample-recovery.html): resampled future factors, recovery bands, final gaps, and cost.
- [Deferral-fraction frontier](reference/deferral-frontier.html): 0-25% risk-ranked scope sweep with completion, residual risk, recovery, and cost.
- [Frontier validation](reference/frontier-validation.html): out-of-sample recovery and cost for every frontier candidate.
- [Scenario-robust static plan](reference/robust-plan.html): training-path budget/capacity robustness, out-of-sample risk and budget performance.
- [Sampled budget chance constraint](reference/chance-plan.html): chance budget relaxation with hard capacity and out-of-sample results.
- [Chance-constrained capacity](reference/chance-capacity-plan.html): sampled budget/capacity relaxation and its negative result.
- [100-path chance constraint](reference/chance-100-plan.html): retrained budget chance at 8% out-of-sample violation and higher residual risk.
- [Two-stage recourse](reference/two-stage.html): first-year fixed plan with budget/capacity deferral after factor observation; multi-year annual recourse results included.
- [Rolling recourse](reference/rolling-recourse.html): static, fixed-future recourse, rolling-only, and rolling-recourse policies on common factors.

- [Plan and bid exchange](reference/plan-exchange.html): shared plan cost build-up, owner/contractor views, bid comparison, fair range, and approval.

- [Planning studio](reference/studio.html): artifact endpoints, 2D map, 3D walkthrough/pre-post, skins, Pareto, timeline, and SSE.

- [Demo portal](reference/demo-portal.html): public synthetic portfolio, static builder, instance pages, pilot brief, and read-only validation.

- [Verification and BAU](reference/verification.html): 16 criteria, measured BAU/monitoring/exchange evidence, scale gap, replay, and recommendation.

- [Release 0.1.4](reference/release.html): release notes, known gaps, artifact build, clean install, demo, and approval gate.

- [Operations and maintenance](reference/operations.html): review cadence, dependency/pin audit, governance register, handover, and pilot evidence.
